items.quote: One GTM API to find prospects, enrich contacts and companies, verify emails, and check job changes.
items.why: Quote covers prospecting, enrichment, email verify, job checks. Omits 30+ providers and phone enrichment.

items.quote: Authenticate data and account API requests with your Waterfall API key in the `x-api-key` header.
items.why: Quote states API key sent in x-api-key header. Matches the key part of the claim.

items.quote: [Contact the team](mailto:support@waterfall.io) for API access and pricing.
items.why: Contact-team-for-access and pricing is consistent with gating. Doesn't state partner_gated or review or benchmark.

items.quote: Commitments and minimums are set at contract and depend on volume and term
items.why: Custom contract pricing with volume terms matches the pricing detail only, not the gate.

items.quote: The Waterfall API is available at `https://api.waterfall.io`.
items.why: Base URL matches. Nothing about the 13 endpoint groups, async flow, or Preview.

items.quote: For **async** APIs, the launcher returns a `job_id`.
items.why: Async job_id launch matches one sub-point. Fetch, webhook, and endpoint count not covered.

items.quote: Run contact and company lookups with an agent, or build Waterfall into your application using the official API skills.
items.why: Quote mentions agents and official API skills. Says nothing about an MCP server existing or not.
